instruction: Move all food processors from my amazon cart to wish list.
notes: Cart contents are unknown up front, so the problem uses placeholder cart products (two food processors, one other product); the real number of entries is discovered at runtime from amazon.show_cart. show_cart asserts (cart-contents-known) (ids and quantities of all entries), show_product reveals each entry's product_type, and move_product_from_cart_to_wish_list is only applicable to products known to be food processors, so non-food-processor entries structurally stay in the cart (matching the evaluation that only food processor rows change in CartEntry/WishListEntry). The full cart quantity is passed explicitly to the move call so wish-list quantities match. supervisor-complete-task takes the two moved products as non-API record parameters (distinct via equality) so its precondition mirrors the goal without naming problem objects in the domain.
